import json,sys,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,stream,crypto,datagram,trace
from h import run
def T(events,**kw): return run({"traces":[trace(events,**kw)]})['traces'][0]
def ack(largest,delay,first,pairs=(),ecn=None):
    b=bytes([0x03 if ecn else 0x02])+v(largest)+v(delay)+v(len(pairs))+v(first)
    for g,r in pairs: b+=v(g)+v(r)
    if ecn: b+=v(ecn[0])+v(ecn[1])+v(ecn[2])
    return b
